name: Flex
summary: A flexbox container with the DS spacing scale baked into `gap` — direction, align, justify, wrap.
lead: ONE custom element — <aha-flex> — defined once, imported unchanged by React and Vue. Shadow-DOM CSS, themed only by --aha-* tokens; `gap` takes the named steps small/middle/large (8/16/24) or a raw pixel number, and direction/align/justify/wrap map straight to flexbox. Layout only — it never paints a background. Zero drift.
codeNote: Same element, same shadow-DOM CSS → identical render. React (< 19) consumes it via a thin wrapper; Vue binds the custom element natively. The primitive is defined once in @ahaslides-product/design.

spec.label: Gap scale
spec.value: small 8 · middle 16 · large 24 (or a raw px number)

spec.label: Direction
spec.value: row · row-reverse · column · column-reverse (or `vertical` for column)

props.name: gap
props.desc: Space between items — named DS step (8/16/24) or a raw pixel number

props.name: vertical
props.desc: Stack in a column — AntD's boolean shorthand for direction=column (direction wins if both set)

props.name: direction
props.desc: Main-axis direction (flex-direction) — the full matrix; overrides `vertical`

props.name: justify
props.type: start | center | end | space-between | space-around | space-evenly

props.name: wrap
props.desc: Allow items to wrap onto multiple lines

whenToUse.when: arranging a block of items in one dimension with consistent DS spacing
you need two-dimensional rows-and-columns, not a single flow
you only need even gaps between a small inline set of items

opinion.note: Keep gaps on the named scale (small/middle/large) so spacing stays consistent across surfaces — reach for a raw pixel number only for a genuine one-off. Flex is layout, never decoration: it paints no background.
opinion.dsv3: COVERED — DS V3 has no measured Flex cell; spec derived from the DS spacing scale (8/16/24) + AntD Flex conventions (gap steps, direction/align/justify/wrap). A deliberate, documented layout extension; the only visual token it binds is inherited text colour.

snippets.label: HTML
snippets.note: The native form — a web component in an HTML file renders on open, no build step. The fast path for vibe-coding.

selfCheck.label: direction / align / justify map to flexbox

conformance.$about: Measured by qa.mjs against the RENDERED UI (getComputedStyle via headless CDP). Leaf = ONE shared element, single render.
